intent: Close the exact-head CI truth completeness failure introduced by the new desktop-shell verification lane: classify the PR-visible desktop-shell check as an advisory desktop build signal with the same make target used by the workflow contract, without changing branch-protection requirements or weakening completeness enforcement.

negative_controls.name: missing-desktop-contract-is-caught

interface_mismatches: The new tests/desktop-shell PR-visible job had no row in docs/governance/CI_TRUTH_CONTRACT.json, so both full Python matrices correctly failed CI truth completeness after otherwise passing 16,181 tests.
The first remediation packet focused on toolchain and lockfile contracts but did not run tests/test_ci_truth_contract_completeness.py, so it did not detect the missing registry row before push.
honest_blockers: This follow-up exists because exact-head hosted CI found an omission that the first focused verifier did not cover. Both Python matrices failed on the same single missing desktop-shell contract row; the failure is not classified as flaky or ignored.

The desktop-shell job is advisory rather than required because this packet does not alter the branch-protection required-context manifest. It remains PR-visible and completeness-enforced, with make desktop-shell-check as its local reproduction command.
The two medium dependency alerts outside PR 1447 remain tracked in issue 1448 and are not changed or claimed resolved here.
session_entry.rollback: Revert this packet and its CI truth row together. That rollback will intentionally restore the exact completeness failure for every PR that publishes the desktop-shell check; it must not be described as a safe green state.
